basis: Static upper-bound review: per-cell ceil rounding at fractional positive acceleration can exceed physical speed20 and falsely trip the next primitive guard.
soundness_proof: Preflight gives v0+ceil(max(0,a,after_a)*H/T)<=20S, therefore exact actor v(t)<=20S for all t. Intersecting computed upper velocity with20S preserves enclosure. Position upper remains outward and unchanged.
domain_proof: Registered V2 actors have a=after_a<=0 and initial v<=10S; all P5 lead motions also have a in{0,-4S} and v<=10S. Their computed upper v never exceeds20S, so min is identity. Only new fractional-positive-acceleration directed vectors exercise this repair.
cache_proof: All nominal geometry actor motions generated by lead_motion are nonpositive, so adapter cache results are globally unchanged on its valid domain.
